title: GeoServer 3.0.1 complete catalog-field migration and loss comparator

source.description: A reviewed GeoServer 3.0.1 REST-shaped catalog export covers workspace/namespace, PostGIS store, feature type/layer, SLD styles, ordered layer group, service metadata, and security differences.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: All 67 reviewed GeoServer 3.0.1 source fields receive one exact import, validation, extension, identity-resolution, rejected-secret, or explicit-loss decision.

The resolved migration template uses the tenant-safe bounded catalog bulk API and preserves service metadata, verified-store identity, top-to-bottom layer order, and exact default/alternate SLD revisions atomically.
Raw connection coordinates and credentials never enter catalog configuration or the evidence report; unsupported settings, live synchronization, deployment, concurrency, and scale remain explicit.
